verdict.rationale: React docs confirm SSR streaming while fetching data and that frameworks implementing React's model let async components fetch data on the server (react-docs-6, react-docs-7), which aligns with Suspense-based data loading, but the pack never explicitly mentions React's `use()`/resource primitive, client-side reactive resource state, or a hands-on demo of a loading UI built with these primitives. missing for 10: explicit mention of the `use()` hook/resource primitive, first-party guidance on building suspense-based loading UIs, independent developer corroboration of the pattern.
